card.name: Partway through multi-part terms and numbers
card.fires_on: Joining marks, spaces and short word pieces in the middle of compound terms or number ranges. Examples are a hyphen after High or Low, the og in hypoglycemia, and the space before a number in a range.

modes.label: Hyphen after a level word
modes.description: A hyphen right after High or Low in a heading, before the next word such as Risk or Grade.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A space between a number or unit and the next number, in ranges or tables.

modes.label: Inside long words
modes.description: A word piece partway through a longer word such as hypoglycemia.
